_meta.title: SHRS Institutional Record
_meta.discipline: Every entry carries `basis`: how we know it. Levels: capture (preserved page in docs/legacy-migration/), press-snippet (search-index snippet of an article whose body is not yet archived), registry-snippet (CAC-derived aggregator snippet), self-published (the school's own statement), school-confirmation-needed (awaiting a fact only the school holds). Nothing may be promoted a level without new evidence. Generated pages must render the caveat wherever basis is not 'capture' or 'archived-original'.

sources.headline: Sultan Hanafi Royal Schools: Illuminating Minds and Nurturing Communities
sources.date_basis: search-result summaries, twice independently; not yet read on-page
key_quotes: Nestled within Imowonla town, in the Ikorodu area of Lagos State, the school radiates the light of knowledge, offering a lifeline of hope
sources.notes: First known national coverage. Snippets also carry the Fashola-era origin of the founding idea.

sources.headline: Education projects, seeds for future generations – Makinde
sources.date_basis: search-result summaries; Edugist mirror dated a day later
key_quotes: He spoke at the unveiling of a faith-based Sultan Hanafi Royal College in Ikorodu, Lagos, and donated N10m to help train less privileged students.
Mr Anofi is not only a colleague but my Chief Accountant, and if he had not been a person of integrity, I wouldn't be here today.
When you start an educational project, you are planting a seed for the future.
sources.notes: The unveiling of Sultan Hanafi Royal College. Single independent origin (the Edugist copy is a reprint of the same text). Adversarial verification: identity with THIS school confirmed by three independent query paths; corroboration remains single-source until the article body is archived.

sources.headline: Winners emerge in N1.5m Quran competition
sources.date_basis: search-result summaries; consistent with Ramadan 2025 (1–30 March)
key_quotes: Winners have emerged in the second Ramadan Quran competition organised by the Sultan Hanafi Royal College, Ikorodu, Lagos.
This is the second year we are organising the Sultan Annual Quran Competition, and it is already the best and first of its kind in Nigeria.
sources.notes: Names the category winners and quotes the College's director, Ahmed Sulaimon.

milestones.title: Founded
milestones.account: Sultan Hanafi Royal Schools is founded in Ikorodu, named in honour of the founder's late father, Anofi Aliu Akano — a Nigerian Ports Authority clerk whose own education was limited, and who was determined his children's would not be.

milestones.title: The Imowonla campus
milestones.account: The school takes root at its present home: 15 Imowonla Road, AP Bus Stop, off the Gberigbe–Agura Road.

milestones.title: The Foundation is registered
milestones.account: The Sultan Zakariya Hanafi Foundation is registered as an Incorporated Trustee (RC/IT 101703) — the institution's philanthropic arm.

milestones.title: The Islamic & Arabic School is registered
milestones.account: Sultan Hanafi School of Islamic & Arabic Studies is registered with the CAC (RC 2564261), seated at Sultan House, 21 H Road, Olaife Estate, Imowonla.

milestones.title: Community first
milestones.account: Humanitarian relief through the COVID-19 lockdown.

milestones.title: National recognition
milestones.account: The Punch publishes Olawoyin Edris's feature on the school — 'a lifeline of hope' in Imowonla — its first known national coverage.

milestones.title: The unveiling of Royal College
milestones.account: Sultan Hanafi Royal College is unveiled. Governor Seyi Makinde of Oyo State attends in a personal capacity and announces a ₦10 million gift toward educating less-privileged students.
milestones.school_confirmation_needed: exact event date; identities in the commissioning-day photographs

milestones.title: The Second Sultan Annual Qur'an Competition
milestones.account: Winners emerge in the second Ramadan Qur'an competition, with ₦1.5m committed to prizes.

milestones.title: The Third Qur'an Competition advertised
milestones.account: The 2026 Ramadan Annual Qur'an Competition — the third edition — is announced.

milestones.title: Class of 2026
milestones.account: A combined graduation for the Basic School, Junior and Senior Secondary, Qur'an College and Islamiyah School, themed 'Building the Future Ummah Through Holistic Education'.
